title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Inequalities
subject: Quant

questions.q: The number of distinct integer solutions $(x, y)$ of the equation $|x+y|+|x-y|=2$, is:
questions.explain: The equation represents a square with vertices at (1,0), (0,1), (-1,0), and (0,-1). The integer solutions are the vertices and the points on the sides, which total to 8.
questions.subject: Quant

questions.q: The number of distinct real values of ${x}$, satisfying the equation $\max \{x, 2\}-\min \{x, 2\}=|x+2|-|x-2|$, is:
questions.explain: The left side simplifies to $|x-2|$. The equation is $|x-2| = |x+2|-|x-2|$, or $2|x-2| = |x+2|$. Squaring both sides gives $4(x-2)^2 = (x+2)^2$. Solving this quadratic equation yields two distinct real solutions.
